title: World-Class Modern Navigation System with Flyout Mega-Menus, Quick Search (⌘K), and Mobile Ergonomics
author: maintainer
description: Upgraded GALXAI's global navigation architecture to match modern industry leaders (Stripe, Vercel, Linear, GitHub). Features include: 1) Glassmorphic sticky top navigation bar with radial glow and hairline border; 2) Categorized flyout mega-menus for Platform (Sites, Images, Model Arena, Playground, Library), Developers (Developer Hub, Pricing & Catalog, API Keys, Tools), Pricing (Overview, Developer Tier, GALX Pro, Fair Use), and Resources (Knowledge Base, FAQ, Security, Status); 3) Omnipresent Quick Search trigger with global ⌘K/Ctrl+K keyboard integration to BroccoliOmniSearch; 4) Authenticated profile popover with quick links to Account Overview, API Keys, Invoices, Settings, and Sign Out; 5) Accessible, responsive slide-out mobile drawer with categorized accordions and bottom touch navigation bar; 6) Zero public information boundary leaks per AGENTS.md.
